# CANDIDATE: VIX_FILTER_FOR_BEARISH_ENTRIES

**Filed:** 2026-07-21  
**Filer:** chef-nemotron (free-tier autonomous R&D)  
**Type:** filter_change  
**Status:** DRAFT (NEEDS-RATIFICATION per Rule 9)

## Hypothesis

Bearish entries (BEARISH_REJECTION_RIDE_THE_RIBBON) exhibit higher edge when VIX is elevated, reflecting increased fear and move magnitude. Filtering entries to require VIX >= 15 should improve edge_capture on J winner days while avoiding low-VIX choppy environments that produce losers.

## Mechanism

- **Entry trigger:** BEARISH_REJECTION_RIDE_THE_RIBBON setup fires only when live VIX quote (from `mcp__cboe__get_vix`) is >= 15.0 at the trigger bar timestamp.
- **Exit logic:** Unchanged — chart-stop primary, chandelier profit-lock, premium stop catastrophe cap, TP1 runner structure as defined in playbook.
- **State:** No additional state required; uses real-time VIX fetch already available in watcher infrastructure.

## OP-20 disclosures

1. **Account-size assumption:** qty=28 requires $25K+ account to fit 50% per-trade risk cap; $1K paper account realizes ~14% of headline P&L due to contract minimums.
2. **Sample bias:** Stage-1 backtest will use 16-month SPY 5m data (2025-01-02 to 2026-06-18) with VIX filter applied in-sample; overfit risk exists if VIX threshold is optimized to J days; will mitigate by testing multiple thresholds (12,15,18,20) and selecting based on OOS performance.
3. **Out-of-sample:** NEEDS-OOS (walk-forward held-out window to be conducted after Stage-1)
4. **Real-fills:** NEEDS-REAL-FILLS (top 3 J days validation using cached real OPRA fills)
5. **Failure modes:** 
   - Worst day: filter blocks a J winner day if VIX < 15 on that day (e.g., 4/29 VIX ~12 would reject entry, turning +$342 to $0).
   - Max drawdown: could increase if filter causes consecutive missed winners during low-VIX regimes.
   - Blow-up scenario: filter fails catastrophically if VIX data feed gaps cause false rejects/accepts; mitigated by using same VIX source as existing watchers.
6. **Concentration:** unknown -- requires Stage-1 backtest to compute top-5 days % of P&L.

## Pre-merge gate

- Pass gym validators (`backtest/tests/test_vix_filter_*`)
- Walk-forward OOS test showing positive edge_capture and Sharpe ratio >= 0.70
- Real-fills validation on top 3 J days showing <±20% difference from BS-simulated P&L
- No regression on anchor days (byte-identical behavior for non-filtered entries)

## Confidence

5 / 10 -- based on prior observations that VIX 15-20 regime yields highest bearish WR (see V14E_BEAR_ONLY_GATE analysis) but uncertainty remains about threshold stability and interaction with other filters.

## Pre-existing leaderboard impact

Does not conflict with existing candidates; complements V14E_BEAR_ONLY_GATE and similar VIX-conditioned filters. May overlap with F8_BULL_VIX_GATE_REVAL but opposite direction (bearish vs bullish). Expected to be additive if thresholds are non-overlapping.
